correctness.rationale: Each leaf copies the old hub. In an immediate two-cycle the hub pair (a,b) satisfies two exact majority inequalities; the n-even rule reduces to constant/b/constant by hub weight and yields all distinct balanced pairs; the n-odd four-type classification forces exactly three disjoint families. Fixed points follow independently from the leaf-match condition. Symmetric finite-valued two-time energy excludes longer periods. Two independent standalone checkers cover all 21,840 graph states for orders 2–7 and the four-type multinomial identities for 59 orders through 60; finite checks support but do not replace the proof. The stated Stirling asymptotics follow from the exact formulas.

value.rationale: This exact all-size recurrent-population classification concerns the canonical clique corona: a dense consensus core with one private one-step-memory leaf at each hub. It proves a structural even/odd transition in immediate oscillation frequency, from 2/(pi*n) to sqrt(2*n/pi)*2^{-n}, plus fixed-state populations and complete period-one/two census. It is not a numerical slice or renaming of another graph-family result; the mechanism is the central binomial balance constraint of the pair-word update. No basin census or unrelated downstream theorem is claimed.
